quality_filter.note: Pairs excluded if either image's FaceQNet quality score is below the bottom-N% cutoff (computed on the full scored LFW population) or if SCRFD detection failed on that image. Filtering applied via the same None-cache-entry mechanism baseline_pipeline.py already uses for undetected faces -- lfw_10fold/compute_fairness_metrics unmodified.

latency.note: Re-measured 2026-09-11 (median of 3 clean n_warmup=100/n_runs=1000 repeats) after the original session's INT8 p95 (62.1ms) was traced to external system contention on this shared laptop (background RGB-sync processes ASUS Aura/NGenuity, Balanced power plan), not an ORT/INT8 kernel issue -- the whole original session ran under elevated background load, so FP32 numbers were re-measured too for an apples-to-apples comparison. See dissertation note on benchmarking environment caveats.

latency_note: Reused from the unfiltered baseline run for this model -- latency is a per-inference model property independent of which pairs are included in the accuracy/fairness stats.
